description: This is a stratigraphy: each token is a centred stack of horizontal bars of varying length, weight and opacity, floating in a large near-black field, reading like a core sample, a sediment cross-section, or a stack of sedimented text lines seen from far enough away that the words have dissolved. The vocabulary is only two primitives — long thin horizontal strips, and small rotated quadrilaterals (squares tipped a few degrees, each creased diagonally into a lighter and a darker facet) that either sit embedded inside the band stack or orbit above and below it. The palette is tight and consistent across all twelve: a dark charcoal ground, slate blue-grey, warm ochre/amber, tan and cream, and a dead brown; each token leans either cool (9011, 10085, 10622, 10980 read blue-grey) or warm (9548, 9727, 10443 read ochre and tan), with amber used sparingly as the brightest accent near the centre. The frame is barely used — every token is a centred island with wide empty margins on all four sides, nothing bleeds, nothing touches an edge, and the horizontal axis always dominates. What the twelve share is that stratified centre-weighted mass and the palette; what separates them is density and extent — 10443 and 10622 are dense full-width fields of forty or more long lines, 9011 and 10264 are compact striped blocks, 9906 is five bars and almost nothing else, and 10801 is the outlier with no bands at all, only six small grey squares in two rows. Across the three conditions the change is one of weight and count rather than of layout: neutral shows many fine hairlines, stress consolidates them into fewer, thicker, heavier, higher-contrast slabs while the orbiting quads grow larger, and recovery returns to a finer, more numerous, more dispersed striation that lands close to but not identical to neutral.
seenAt120: The centred striped mass survives as a silhouette and the warm/cool split survives clearly — you can tell 9727 and 10443 (warm dense) from 10622 (grey dense) from 9011 (small cool block) at a glance, and the orbiting-square tokens (9369, 10801) are distinct in silhouette. What is lost is the individual hairline: the fine striations merge into a single textured smudge, so the medium-density tokens collapse toward the same shape and are separated mainly by hue and by overall width. The two sparse tokens fail at this size — 9906 becomes a tiny illegible smear and 10801 becomes six faint grey dots with no visible relationship to the rest of the set.
